label: Univers
description: The full Genome lightness grid. Numbers identify scale positions; contrast is measured from the actual HEX.

label: Genome
description: Genome’s original color and neutral mappings. Exact inputs can fall short of the contrast usually associated with a step.

label: IBM Carbon
description: Genome-generated shades with Carbon-style 10–100 labels. These are not IBM’s published palette or theme tokens.

label: Salesforce Lightning
description: Genome lightness targets with Lightning-style labels. Does not load Salesforce’s palette or SLDS theme tokens.

label: Adobe Spectrum
description: Legacy 100–1300 mapping. Adobe now separates Spectrum 2 from S1; this mapping implements neither official token dataset.

label: Ant Design
description: Genome-generated shades with 1–10 labels. Ant uses its own color generator; matching labels does not mean matching colors.

label: Material
description: Legacy 50–900 mapping. Material 3 uses HCT tonal palettes and dynamic schemes; this preset is not Material 3.

label: Accessible Palette
description: A fixed Genome mapping inspired by Accessible Palette. The source tool supports adjustable lightness and interpolation; this is not a synchronized palette.

label: ColorBox
description: A legacy fixed mapping. ColorBox uses configurable hue, saturation and luminosity curves and step counts, rather than this Genome mapping.
